expression:
local({
  items <- cbind(SDQ2, SDQ5, SDQ8, SDQ11, SDQ14, SDQ17, SDQ20, SDQ23, SDQ26, SDQ29)
  answered <- rowSums(items >= 1 & items <= 4 & items == round(items), na.rm = TRUE)
  rev_items <- cbind(SDQ5, SDQ11, SDQ17, SDQ23, SDQ29)
  unreversed <- rowSums(ifelse(!is.na(rev_items) & rev_items != round(rev_items), 5 - 2 * rev_items, 0))
  if_else(answered >= 5, as.numeric(SDQ_academic) + unreversed, NA_real_)
})
